exclusion_detail: The paper gives procedures only for the hydrazinecarboxylates 2 (ketone 1 + ethyl carbazate) and the Hurd-Mori cyclisation to the thiadiazoles 3 (SOCl2). The starting ketones 1 are said to be 'prepared via boron trifluoride diethyl etherate mediated reaction between commercially available 4-substituted benzene-1,3-diols and carboxylic acids [21, 22]' with no procedure or characterisation in this paper, so the first step is cited only. The abstract also names no single lead.

lead.label: 3fa (cyclopentylmethyl compound; named only in the Conclusion)
lead.why: Conclusion: 'compound with cyclopentylmethyl moiety (3fa) performed best in both Hsp90 binding and cell growth inhibitory assays.' The abstract names no single compound (four compounds with Kd 0.6-0.8 nM).

notes: No SI in the bundle. All 14 compounds 3 share the uncited-procedure ketone step, so none qualifies. Reading the lead as 3fa from the Conclusion is a judgement; the abstract-based rule would give no_lead_identifiable. Either way excluded.
